scripts.//: A comment example for package.json scripts.
The next line has -p meaning `pointing/using` tsconfig.json, which is the default behavior of tsc, but it's good to be explicit.
If we want an actual bundle in production when we build, we run build, (perhaps preceeded by the typecheck script for safety's sake), then start (execute the built output in dist/)
but this build step is not necessary for tsx to run the app, as tsx can run TypeScript files directly and we wont need a bundle at all!!
Alternatively (using esbuild or regular tsc to build), start would be `node dist/app.js (tsc output)`, or node esbuild.config.js (build/bundle config)
